component.name: After the Flood Sparks
component.summary: After the Flood Sparks, a font to display charts within text

description.p: After the Flood Sparks is a font that allows for the combination of text and visual data to show an idea and evidence in one headline. This builds on the principle of Sparkslines defined by Edward Tufte and makes them easier to use. Sparkslines are currently available as plugins or javascript elements. By installing the Sparks font you can use them immediately without the need for custom code.

Sparks data needs to be formatted as comma-separated values, with curly brackets at both ends of the set, e.g., {30,60,90}. You can also have numbers at the beginning and end of the set, which are useful for providing the start and end points, e.g., 123{30,60,90}456 – Sparks has numerals built in.
